byLayer.description: Split domain+data stream from presentation stream when a single feature exceeds page/bloc threshold

byFeature.description: Split independent features into separate streams (one agent per stream)

notes.rule: 'any' = trigger team mode if ANY threshold is met. 'all' = require all thresholds. 'majority' = >=50% of thresholds met.
notes.maxParallelAgents: Hard cap. Streams beyond this are batched into the existing agents sequentially.
notes.splitStrategy: 'by-layer-then-feature' = first split domain+data vs presentation; if still too large, split presentation by page groups. 'by-feature-only' = never split a single feature across agents.
